hookScope: Set a hook on a scope the product owns, not on :root, so a runtime change restyles that scope only. To change one orientation only, set the hook on [data-orientation] within the scope, for example .promo [data-orientation="vertical"] { --scnx-tabs-highlight-background-hover: …; }; without it, the hook applies to every orientation in the scope.
